to.rules: The Eight-Mile Trail to the rock enters the Boulder River Wilderness, where groups are capped at 12 people and stock combined.
to.land_manager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Darrington Ranger District)

held.why: HELD (brief V: approach and wilderness differ). The candidate object from wa_three_o_clock_rock_total_soul does not fit Exfoliation Dome. The USFS wilderness layer (EDW_Wilderness_01) returns NO wilderness at the Witch Doctor Wall point (48.1486, -121.5906) or the dome; the nearest Boulder River Wilderness boundary vertex is about 2.0 km from the wall and 1.7 km from the summit. The approach is a climbers' path from a pullout on the Clear Creek road (FR 2060) via an old logging spur and a boulder field, not the Eight-Mile Trail. The USFS ownership layer (EDW_BasicOwnership_01) places the wall on Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest land, so only the land_manager field is supported. No Clear Creek road / FR 2060 site appears on the Region 6 day-use fee list (updated 2026-09-15), so no pass line. Owner choice: a land_manager-only object, or leave null.
